description: Auf Nutzerkorrektur: quadratisches Pergamentsymbol; vier junge hellhäutige Zeitungsausträger mit westlichem Erscheinungsbild; vier Lernszenen mit jungen Schülern und Schülerinnen und einem vornehmen Lehrmeister. Eigene Figuren im gewünschten Anime-Stil.

scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Vertical 2:3 scene illustration for a medieval low-fantasy newspaper guild. Upper bodies and faces are the visual focus. Clean, confident adventure-anime lineart, expressive acting, distinct silhouettes, simple flat colors and crisp two-tone cel shading; the technical drawn art style of One Piece ONLY, with entirely original character designs. Every depicted person has fair/light skin and a Western European appearance. Attractive, individually designed faces with proportionate straight noses, naturally sized almond eyes, normal teeth and hands; expressive but not grotesque. No exaggerated hooked noses, bulging eyes, oversized mouths, missing teeth, giant ears or wrinkled caricatures. No recognizable One Piece cast: no straw hats, spiky black protagonist hair, orange-haired heroine, round Luffy eyes, cheek scars, open red vest, Nami face or costume. Wool/linen/leather period clothing, medieval timber or stone architecture, quills and printed paper; no modern suits, glasses, machinery or clothes. Quiet supporting background. Flat simple anime textures, no photorealism, no painterly surfaces or grain overlay. No text labels, no readable invented headlines, no watermark or frame. Printed papers have simple rows of abstract typesetting and tiny woodcut illustrations, not modern glossy magazine layouts.

Scene and character designs: A lively but polite newspaper boy aged 17 stands in a modest western medieval marketplace. Slim youthful build, fair skin with a few light freckles, soft sandy-blond hair swept sideways under a small moss-green cloth cap, grey-green almond eyes and a relaxed friendly smile with closed lips, softly angular youthful face and small straight nose. Entirely original face, not the previous bowl-cut character. He wears a well-kept simple olive tunic, cream collar and brown wool shoulder cape, and offers one folded local newspaper, a modest bundle tucked under his other arm. Waist-up framing, head comfortably within frame. Simple market awnings and timber houses behind him, fresh gentle morning light, green and warm earth colors. Energetic newspaper delivery by a young lad, no adult newspaper seller.

Scene and character designs: A clever, energetic newspaper boy aged 18 calls out a new edition beside the wooden stalls of a western medieval market. Fair European skin, lean youthful build, chestnut-brown wavy hair with a tidy side part beneath a charcoal wool cap, lively narrow hazel eyes, straight nose, defined but youthful jaw and a small confident calling smile, mouth only slightly open. Entirely original handsome boy, no heroic anime grin. Burgundy wool tunic with a plain grey linen collar, charcoal short cloak. He lifts a folded news sheet in one hand and holds a paper bundle against his chest with the other. Chest-up image, face prominent. Warm sun, muted burgundy, grey and wood colors, simple indistinct townspeople in background. No elderly hawker.

Scene and character designs: A composed newspaper courier aged 18 offers a neatly folded gazette near a stone arch on a western medieval city square. Young, slim and fair-skinned European boy, ash-brown straight hair neatly side-parted and tucked behind his ears, clear blue-grey almond eyes, straight nose and fine youthful facial proportions. A courteous restrained smile, alert dignified expression. Navy wool tabard over ivory linen, modest brass collar clasp, leather strap with bundled papers, small navy cloth cap. Waist-up portrait with face and paper hand prominent. Clean background of pale stone and a distant stall, calm daylight. A professional young newspaper boy, no older bearded man. Navy, cream and muted gold accents, entirely original face.

Scene and character designs: A stylish young newspaper seller aged 18 presents a folded society gazette just outside a refined medieval town salon. Fair-skinned Western European lad, slim youthful build, pale honey-brown hair in soft short waves brushed away from his forehead, grey almond eyes, smooth youthful cheeks, a straight narrow nose and a subtle mischievous but elegant smile. He wears a fitted burgundy wool doublet, ivory high linen collar, dark short cape and a small burgundy cloth cap, all clearly medieval and modest. He holds the gazette chest-high and a second small bundle by his side. Waist-up framing, focus on his original expressive face. A carved doorway, simple leaded window and warm lantern hint at the salon. Background uncluttered, burgundy, ivory and warm brown. No mature woman or aristocratic couple as the main subject.

Scene and character designs: An elite male master of a medieval writing school instructs two young pupils at one desk: a boy aged 18 and a girl aged 18, both fair-skinned Western European young adults with attractive original faces. The boy has neat chestnut hair, hazel almond eyes, simple olive apprentice tunic; the girl has long dark-blond hair braided over one shoulder, blue-grey almond eyes, modest cream blouse with green sleeveless overgown. They watch a carefully corrected line of writing, the girl holding a quill, the boy following the text. Their master is a distinguished European man aged 48: handsome composed long face, straight nose, well-groomed brown hair silvering at the temples, a short neat pointed beard, lifted eyebrow and exacting scholarly gaze. He wears a finely tailored dark green medieval scholar's robe, narrow gold embroidery, cream collar and a signet ring. He points precisely to a correction. Three upper bodies in a close triangular composition, master slightly behind the two pupils, all three faces clear. Quiet arched window and books, soft daytime. Formal, demanding yet constructive tuition, no comic elder caricature.

Scene and character designs: In a tidy medieval print workshop, a distinguished and slightly haughty master printer teaches two attentive young apprentices, a boy of 18 and a girl of 19, all fair-skinned and Western European. Boy: short sandy hair swept to the side, narrow grey eyes, earnest handsome youthful face, charcoal apprentice vest over cream linen. Girl: long medium-brown hair in a single neat braid, hazel almond eyes, attractive youthful face, modest burgundy work dress with cream sleeves. The boy holds a fresh proof sheet while the girl adjusts a small tray of letter blocks; only a few tools visible. Their master: aristocratic man aged 45 with neatly groomed dark brown hair, clean-shaven straight-featured face, arched brow and refined slightly stern expression, burgundy medieval gown with subtle dark embroidery, high ivory linen collar and a signet ring. He raises one precise correcting finger over the proof. Chest/waist-up three-person composition, faces dominate, wooden hand press hinted at behind them, no industrial or modern machinery. Warm late-afternoon light, burgundy, charcoal and cream.

Scene and character designs: An aristocratic head scholar instructs two young students in comparing two sealed dispatches inside a refined medieval editorial study. All are fair-skinned Western European people. The master is a handsome distinguished man aged 50, long straight nose of normal proportions, thoughtful grey eyes, shoulder-length neatly groomed silver-grey hair, trimmed short beard, erect proud posture and a demanding calm expression. Rich navy scholar's robe, restrained gold trim, high ivory collar and signet ring, no modern suit or spectacles. Student boy aged 18: straight chestnut hair in a side part, blue almond eyes, smooth youthful face, plain navy apprentice tunic; student girl aged 18: long ash-blond braid, grey-green almond eyes, youthful attractive face, modest ivory-and-blue medieval gown. Each holds one parchment letter; the master points between a line on each document to make them compare the evidence. Three upper bodies arranged clearly around one desk, master's head slightly above theirs, no overlapping faces. A ledger and inkpot at bottom, quiet stone window and one bookcase behind. Crisp clean anime cel shading, navy, ivory and pale gold.

Scene and character designs: A refined elite master illustrator teaches two young art pupils, one boy aged 18 and one girl aged 19, all fair-skinned Western European. The master: elegant man aged 44 with neatly swept-back dark chestnut hair, clean-shaven straight-featured handsome face, narrow light-grey eyes, faint proud smile and lifted eyebrow; a rich plum-burgundy medieval robe with discreet golden trim, cream high collar, signet ring. The boy has short light-brown hair parted to one side, green almond eyes, youthful slim face, cream linen shirt and modest burgundy apprentice vest. The girl has long dark-blond hair tied in a low braid, grey-blue almond eyes, attractive youthful face, simple ivory blouse and plum overdress. The master holds a quill above the girl's portrait sketch and demonstrates one precise line, while the boy studies a separate pen sketch of a clothed nobleman's exaggerated posture. They learn portrait drawing and tasteful satirical illustration for a society gazette. Only small sketched figures on paper, not extra large faces. Close three-person upper-body composition, faces clear; simple drawing desk, inkpot and softly lit leaded salon window. Refined burgundy, ivory and muted gold, no elderly caricaturist pair.

categoryIcon.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create the square category icon for medieval 'Gilden & Zünfte' in this EXISTING parchment icon set. Image 1 (Techniken) is the square frame/background template; Image 2 (Chroniken) is an additional style reference. Preserve Image 1's entire square 1:1 shape, edge-to-edge opaque ochre parchment, exact thin double rectangular border, large circular ring and four elegant acanthus corner ornaments. Match both references' warm golden ochre and dark sepia ink palette, flat bold clean printed outlines and fine uniform parchment grain. Change ONLY the central icon: replace the sword, staff and arrows with two hands shaking, beneath a crossed small medieval artisan hammer and long goose writing quill. Clear simple central silhouette, balanced big readable shapes, same visual weight and margins as the existing symbols. Guild solidarity, craftsmanship and scribes. Absolutely NO shield shape, NO heraldic coat of arms, NO red, green or silver, NO transparent background, no text or letters, no mockup, no extra border outside the original square. Output a finished 1:1 square bitmap that belongs seamlessly to these exact parchment tiles.
